paite: Unaute aw, na lak ua ka hong lutna uh athawn kei chih noumau mah in na thei uhi.
heading: Paul In Anasep Agum
english: For you yourselves know, brothers, our visit to you wasn’t in vain,

paite: Athawn hih nak sang in huai malam in na theihsa bang un, Philippi a gimthuak leh zumhuaitak a bawl a ka om nung un, dalna thupitak lak ah leng Pathian tanchinhoih na kiang ua gen ding in ka Pathian uah hangsanna ka nei zaw uhi.
english: but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as you know, at Philippi, we grew bold in our God to tell you the Good News of God in much conflict.

paite: Ka thugen uh khemna a pawt ahi kei a, sianlouhna a suak leng ahi kei a, khemna in leng ahi sam kei hi;
english: For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in deception.

paite: tanchinhoih kepsak a om ding a Pathian hoihsakmi ka hih bang ngei un, mihing hihkipak ding hilou a, ka lungtang uh ze-etpa Pathian hihkipak zaw in thu ka gen zel uh ahi zaw hi.
english: But even as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News, so we speak—not as pleasing men, but God, who tests our hearts.

paite: Chik lai peuh in kimaitang phatna thu leh huaiham khuhmangna ding thu ka zong ngei kei uh chih na thei ua; Pathian leng ahon theihpihpa ahi.
english: For neither were we at any time found using words of flattery, as you know, nor a cloak of covetousness (God is witness),

paite: Khrist sawltak ka hih ziak un mite buaisak thei himah le ung, mihing lak ah nou lak ah leh midangte lak ah leng pahtawina ka zong ngei sam kei uhi.
english: nor seeking glory from men (neither from you nor from others), when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.

paite: Nu naupom, ama tate deihthohtak a kemmi bang in, na lak uah nunnemtak in ka om zaw uhi.
english: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.

paite: Huchi in ittak a nou ka hon lunggulh tuntun ziak un, Pathian tanchinhoih kia hilou in, koumau hinna leng hon piak hial ka ut mahmah uhi.
english: Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you not the Good News of God only, but also our own souls, because you had become very dear to us.

paite: Unaute aw, ka septawldan uleh ka sepgimdan uh na theigige uhi; na lak uah kuamah ka suk tuailuailouhna ding un, sun leh zan a nna sem in Pathian tanchinhoih nou ka hon hilh uhi.
english: For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached to you the Good News of God.

paite: Nou gingtate tung a siangthoutak, diktak leh dembei a ka omdan uh ahon theihpihte Pathian leh noute na hi uhi.
english: You are witnesses with God how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.

paite: Na theih mah bang un, pa'n ama tate tung a ahih bang a hanthawn leh khamuan in nou ka hon theisak uhi.
english: As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,

paite: Amah gam leh thupina a nou hon samlutpa Pathian mite hi ding a kilawm him a na hintheihna ding un.
english: to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.

paite: Hiai ziak in tawp lou in Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen uhi, Pathian thu koumau a kipan a na muh uh, na san lai un leng, mihing thu bang in na sang kei ua; Pathian thu ahihna bang a na san zawk ziak un; huai tuh Pathian a ahi him a, gingtami noumau sung a sem zel mah ahi.
heading: Khrist Min A Thuakna
english: For this cause we also thank God without ceasing that when you received from us the word of the message of God, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, God’s word, which also works in you who believe.

paite: Nou unaute aw, Judia gam a Pathian saptuam pawl Khrist Jesu a omte zuite na hi ua, amau Judate lak a athuak bang un, nou leng noumau gam mite lak ah na thuak sam uhi.
english: For you, brothers, became imitators of the assemblies of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus; for you also suffered the same things from your own countrymen, even as they did from the Jews

paite: Huai Judate'n Toupa Jesu leh zawlneite leng athat ua, kou leng ahon delhkhia ua, Pathian ahihlungkim kei ua, mi tengteng akalh nak uhi.
english: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and don’t please God, and are contrary to all men,

paite: Zentelte hotdam ahihtheihna ding ua akiang ua thugen akham ua, akhelhna uh hihdim gige ding in; himahleh atung uah thangpaihna tawpkhawk atungta hi.
english: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved, to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them to the uttermost.

paite: Himahleh unaute aw, sawt lou kal a dia noumau toh lungtang lam a kikhen lou a, pumpi lam kia a kikhen a i om takdih ziak in, kilawptak a na mel uh mu ding in ka pang sansan uhi.
heading: Paul In Thessalonika Veh Nawn A-ut
english: But we, brothers, being bereaved of you for a short season in presence, not in heart, tried even harder to see your face with great desire,

paite: Na kiang ua hong pai ka tum tinten ngal ua; kei, Paul ngei in leng hong pai ka tumtum a, himahleh Setan in ahon dal nak hi.
english: because we wanted to come to you—indeed, I, Paul, once and again—but Satan hindered us.

paite: Ka lametna uhiam, ka lungnopna uhiam, ka Kipahna Lallukhu uhiam bang ahia le? Ahong pai chiang in i Toupa Jesu ma ah noumau mah na hi kei ding ua hia?
english: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Isn’t it even you, before our Lord Jesus at his coming?

paite: Noumau mah ka thupina uleh ka lungnopna uh na hi uhi.
english: For you are our glory and our joy.
